title: Can the original charging machine be reused when relocating and relining a pipe-fitting solution-treatment furnace?
summary: Suneng's 2012 relocation proposal for a rapid stainless-steel pipe-fitting solution-treatment furnace renews the lining and natural-gas heating system while reusing the rapid loading/unloading fork truck, with new controls and limits. Review the existing forks and trays together with renewed hearth supports. Keeping the truck does not establish unchanged furnace-entry and water-immersion routes after relocation.
